JaggedPass_Text_EricIntro:
MT. CHIMNEY's JAGGED PASS…
Now this is what I've always wanted in a mountain.
This jagged bumpiness… It rocks my soul!
JaggedPass_Text_EricPostBattle:
Yes, I did lose at POKéMON…
But, when it comes to the love of the mountains, I have you beat!
JaggedPass_Text_DianaIntro: This place isn't your casual hike. It's not suited for a picnic.
JaggedPass_Text_DianaDefeat: Ohhh, no! The ground is too bumpy…
JaggedPass_Text_DianaPostBattle:
Did you know?
Some people cleverly ride their bicycles up this horribly bumpy pass.
JaggedPass_Text_DianaRegister: Will you ever be back in this area? If you do return, I'd like a rematch.
JaggedPass_Text_DianaRematchIntro: Picnics are fun wherever you go. Just like POKéMON!
JaggedPass_Text_DianaRematchDefeat: I only lost because the ground is too bumpy!
JaggedPass_Text_DianaPostRematch: I'll forget about losing and just enjoy this bumpy hike.
JaggedPass_Text_EthanIntro: JAGGED PASS is hard to walk on. It's a good place for training.
JaggedPass_Text_EthanDefeat: It was all over while we were still trying to find a good footing…
JaggedPass_Text_EthanPostBattle: If I had an ACRO BIKE, I'd be able to jump ledges.
JaggedPass_Text_EthanRegister:
When I get more used to this bumpiness, I'll be sure to win!
Can you register me in your POKéNAV?
JaggedPass_Text_EthanRematchIntro: I got used to this bumpiness. I sing while I climb now.
JaggedPass_Text_EthanRematchDefeat: It's still not easy to battle on this bumpy ground…
JaggedPass_Text_EthanPostRematch: I should get an ACRO BIKE from RYDEL in MAUVILLE CITY…
JaggedPass_Text_GruntIntro:
Wah! What are you doing here?
What am I doing in a place like this?
What business is it of yours?
JaggedPass_Text_GruntDefeat:
Urrrgh…
I should've ducked into our HIDEOUT right away…
JaggedPass_Text_GoWhereverYouWant:
Okay, oh-kay! I admit it--you're strong!
Don't worry about me. Go wherever you want!
JaggedPass_Text_BoulderShakingInResponse: Oh! This boulder is shaking in response to the MAGMA EMBLEM!
JaggedPass_Text_JulioIntro: Aiyeeh! It's awfully scary to shoot down the mountain in one go!
JaggedPass_Text_JulioDefeat: I feel like I'm falling apart…
JaggedPass_Text_JulioPostBattle: My bicycle bounced around so much, my rear end's sore…
JaggedPass_Text_AutumnIntro: I climb this hill every day. I have confidence in my strength!
JaggedPass_Text_AutumnPostBattle: What is that odd rock protrusion a little up the hill from here?
